prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Minecraft Java item texture for an astral gem enhancement reagent. Create ONE original vanilla-Minecraft-style inventory sprite on a genuinely transparent background. Production constraint: the design is exactly a 16 by 16 logical pixel grid, enlarged only by nearest-neighbor square blocks for display. Every edge, highlight and shadow must align to that same 16x16 grid. No detail smaller than one logical pixel. Center the item, upright, with a one-pixel transparent margin. The entire sprite should fit in roughly 12x14 logical pixels. Flat limited palette, at most 10 colors, a dark 1-pixel outline, crisp stepped edges, 2-3 flat shading tones, upper-left highlight. A small brown cork and pale glass bottle rim unify the set. Bottle has a recognizable silhouette and colored contents, with no label or lettering. No antialiasing, smooth gradients, subpixel details, photographic lighting, drop shadow, ground, backdrop, grid lines, text, watermark, frame, or other items. The image itself must be square. Subject: gem impurity cleansing reagent. A round, broad-shouldered potion vial with a short neck, filled with amethyst-purple liquid; one tiny pale square highlight evokes cleansing. Use deep plum outline, violet contents, lavender highlight, muted pale blue glass and brown cork. Keep the silhouette simple and compact, readable at 16x16.
